pr.title: Drop the "Plan: " prefix from every project's heading
pr.head: 44016f80f22d18ada4627340003a9070e252e323

summary: Each project in this repository has a plan: a readme.md in its own directory under docs/projects/. Projector, the tool that manages those plans and builds the repository's project site, takes each project's title from the plan's first # heading, word for word. Every plan but one opened with # Plan: …, so every title in project list, project show, and on the site began with the same word.

This pull request deletes Plan: from those 51 headings and changes nothing else in any file. Three headings would then start with an ordinary lowercase word, so they also gain a capital. Headings that start with a name the docs keep lowercase, such as bloom and prettier, keep it lowercase.

The repository's own rule in docs/projects/README.md already says to open a plan with a # Title, so the change brings the plans in line with it. Other documents and code comments cite a plan by its directory name, as in project-core.md §3.2, so no citation depends on a title.

cards.title: Where a plan's title shows
cards.html:
• project list and project show. Each row shows the title beside the project's directory name and status.
  • The project site's project pages. The site takes titles from the plans on main. Its workflow redeploys on every push to main under docs/, so the new titles appear when this merges.
  • The site's proposed projects. A plan that an open pull request adds is listed from that pull request's newest summary, with the title its own heading gives.

Plan citations and each summary's project field use the directory name, which this change leaves alone.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
One review, of 44016f8, found the head clean with no finding threads. It left two suggestions, both about things outside this diff:

  • Two new plans keep the prefix. #185 adds docs/projects/install/readme.md and #202 adds docs/projects/instrument-knobs/readme.md, each still opening with # Plan:. Each needs a one-line edit on its own branch.
  • The description's paragraph about open pull requests. It says #185 changes plan bodies, but #185 adds a new plan. It also leaves out #201 and #202. All six open pull requests that touch plans merge cleanly with this head.

groups.title: Every plan heading drops its prefix
groups.kicker: 48 headings lose Plan: and keep the rest of their wording
intro: In each of these plans the only change is the first heading: # Plan: Arming becomes # Arming. The frontmatter above the heading and the plan below it are untouched, so no project's status, priority, or content changes.

A few headings start with a name the docs write in lowercase or in code font. bloom moves into field, prettier and ESLint, src/engine umbrella, and the two headings that open with a field command keep their first word as it was rather than gaining a capital.

checks.text: git grep 'Plan:' at the head finds nothing in the repository. At the base it finds exactly the 51 headings this pull request edits, and no code, test, script, or link that reads them.

project list --json at the base and at the head, compared project by project: each of these 48 titles differs only by the missing Plan: , and every project's name, status, priority, owner, and path is unchanged. project check at the head reports the plans valid.

22 of these plans are completed. docs/projects/README.md says not to rewrite a finished plan to match later reality. A title change leaves what the plan records as it was, so that rule is not in play.

Two open pull requests add plans that still open with # Plan:, and those plans are not on this branch: #185 adds docs/projects/install/readme.md, and #202 adds docs/projects/instrument-knobs/readme.md. After this merges, theirs are the only prefixed titles in project list and on the site. Decide whether to drop the prefix on those two branches.

groups.title: Three headings also gain a capital
groups.kicker: Headings that would start with a lowercase ordinary word now start with a capital
intro: Three headings continued after Plan: with an ordinary word in lowercase, which read naturally after the colon. Without the prefix, that word opens the heading, so this pull request capitalizes it. That matches the sentence-case headings AGENTS.md asks for.

checks.text: In the project list --json comparison between the base and the head, these three are the only titles that differ by more than the missing prefix.

files.note: The plan for hosting AU and VST3 plugins as inserts. hosted plugins — AU and VST3 as inserts becomes Hosted plugins — AU and VST3 as inserts. The plan is in-progress with priority now, so this title shows near the top of project list.
